API permission: PERMISSION_VIRTUALSERVICE

parameters.name: X-Avi-Version
parameters.description: The caller is required to set Avi Version Header to the expected version of configuration. The response from the controller will provide and accept data according to the specified version. The controller will reject POST and PUT requests where the data is not compatible with the specified version.

parameters.name: X-CSRFToken
parameters.description: Avi Controller may send back CSRF token in the response cookies. The caller should update the request headers with this token else controller will reject requests.

name.description: Name of the referenced object. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

tenant_ref.description: URI of the Tenant that owns this object, omitted for global objects with no tenant reference. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

type.description: Avi object type/model name of the referenced object (e.g. VirtualService, Pool). Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

uuid.description: UUID of the referenced object. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

count.description: Number of entries in results. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

results.description: Objects returned by the referred_by/refers_to graph traversal. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.
